description: This file contains JavaScript code defining a drag-and-drop list component within the SuiteCRM Module Builder. It includes a constructor function Studio2.ListDD, extension of YAHOO.util.DDProxy for drag behavior, and methods for handling drag events, updating tabs, and styling during drag-and-drop operations.

classes.name: Studio2.ListDD
classes.description: A constructor function for a draggable list element implementing a customized drag-and-drop behavior

methods.name: copyStyles
methods.description: A set of style properties copied during dragging to restore styles after drag

methods.name: startDrag
methods.description: Initializes the drag operation, styles the drag element, and handles edit termination

methods.name: updateTabs
methods.description: Updates the tab interface based on current list items

methods.name: endDrag
methods.description: Completes the drag operation, restores styles, and handles removal or repositioning of elements

methods.name: onDrag
methods.description: A placeholder for the YAHOO.util.DDProxy onDrag event handler (assumed to be defined elsewhere)

methods.name: onDragOver
methods.description: Handles the visual cues and insertion logic when a draggable is moved over droppable targets

methods.name: Studio2.ListDD
methods.description: Constructor for the draggable list object, initializing drag properties and styles
